name: demo-selenium-go
summary: A small Go walkthrough demo that uses `github.com/tebeka/selenium` to drive Chrome, navigate to testingexamples.github.io, and demonstrate locator strategies and form interactions.
description: Demonstration of Selenium browser automation using Go and github.com/tebeka/selenium, navigating to https://testingexamples.github.io/en-001/practice/ and demonstrating locating elements by id, name, class, link text, and XPath, then filling a text input, checking a checkbox, checking a radio button, and selecting an option in a select element.
